specification.objective: Make desktop workspace navigation and mobile drawer one consistent, accessible navigation system and remove animations only between workspace routes for TouchIn issue #119, preserving auth and history behavior and excluding #120.

requirements.statement: Define the six workspace destinations and logout once and consume them in desktop and drawer navigation.
Render the same navigation item component and interaction states in desktop and drawer layouts.
Render the same navigation brand component and color treatment in desktop and drawer layouts.
Use colorScheme.surface for the desktop panel and restrict accent color to the brand block; preserve 360 px expanded width.
Mark the current route visually and with Semantics.selected in both layouts from one shell-owned route source.
Meet WCAG AA contrast in light and dark themes for normal, selected, hover, and focus states.
Keep desktop contextual content subordinate in a single scroll flow and legible at short viewport heights.
Do not repeat page title or description in the contextual panel.
Make 1080 px the single navigation breakpoint decision owned by the shell.
Show persistent desktop navigation at widths >=1080 px and a menu-triggered drawer below 1080 px.
Render Kanban within the shared workspace shell without its own navigation or brand bar.
Remove transitions between workspace routes while preserving the login-to-workspace transition and drawer open/close animation.
Preserve routes, deep links, browser history, active-route deduplication, forward-branch truncation, logout, and canonical redirects.
Preserve #112 route-session skeleton behavior during session revalidation.
Do not add dependencies or alter backend, authentication, authorization, session, API, or data behavior.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Desktop and drawer expose the same six destinations and logout in the same order, through shared item and brand widgets.
The current destination is visually selected and Semantics.selected in both layouts.
Rendered navigation colors meet 4.5:1 text and 3:1 icon/focus contrast in both themes and tested states.
The desktop panel uses surface background with accent only on brand, remains 360 px expanded, and has one scroll flow.
The panel omits duplicate page title and description while page content retains them.
Breakpoint behavior is desktop persistent at 1080 and drawer-only at 1079; no nested widget recalculates navigation breakpoint.
Kanban uses shared shell navigation and preserves board scrolling/content.
After one pump, navigation to another workspace route has zero transition duration, animation value 1, and previous route removed.
Login-to-first-workspace transition and mobile drawer open/close animation remain enabled.
Back/Forward, direct links, reload, deduplication, branch truncation and logout behavior pass widget and browser history smoke tests.
Session revalidation continues showing the #112 route-local skeleton and auth redirects.
No new pubspec dependencies, auth/session/API/backend/data changes, or #120 rail behavior appear in the diff.
POLIS strict validation gates and responsive visual inspection are recorded for this implementation.

invariants.statement: Opaque token storage and all authentication/session flows are unchanged.
Role authorization remains enforced by existing pages and APIs; navigation destination visibility is unchanged.
ModalRoute.settings.name, route keys, canonical URLs, and existing accessibility/smoke selectors remain available.
Only duplicate panel title/description is removed; page content retains its labels and descriptions.
No backend, migration, data, API, or existing POLIS contract changes.

forbidden_states.statement: Desktop and drawer destination order, labels, route, active semantics, or item styling diverge.
Navigation text contrast falls below 4.5:1 or icon/focus contrast below 3:1 in either theme.
Panel uses multiple independently scrolling areas or duplicates page title/description.
Hamburger appears at >=1080 px or desktop navigation remains at <1080 px.
Any workspace-to-workspace route animates, or login-to-workspace/drawer animation is removed.
Back/Forward, authentication guards, logout, or #112 route skeleton behavior regresses.
Issue #120 rail/collapse/persistence behavior is implemented in this change.

inputs.statement: Workspace route navigation from menu, Back/Forward and programmatic navigation; responsive viewport and light/dark theme.

outputs.statement: Shared desktop and mobile workspace navigation with contrast-safe states and zero workspace route transitions.
Automated and visual validation evidence for issue #119.

failure_semantics.statement: On the locked base, the transition regression fails with workspace_route_transition_missing because MaterialPage uses a nonzero default transition.

argv: workspace route transitions are zero after the first workspace route

import subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.run(['flutter','test','test/core/navigation/workspace_route_transition_test.dart','--plain-name','workspace route transitions are zero after the first workspace route'],cwd='frontend'); print('workspace_route_transition_missing' if p.returncode else 'workspace_route_transition_present'); sys.exit(p.returncode)
